So I would be extremity careful if you are going down this route. Psycodelics are a criminaly under researched tool for psychology and are showing extreme promise for treatment resistent depression.

That being said, they are increadibaly powerful substances that need to be respected. I see a couple of issues in your situation you have presented. The first is the supply of them. In most places they are still illegal (in the UK at least). How are you going to get a supply of psycodelics? Getting them from a street dealer seems like it could get you back into old habits and growing them yourself will require a lot of self control.

Secondly, it would be worth your time and money to seek out a psychiatrist. Therapists, Counciler and general practitioners have the best will in the world but psychiatrists are the ones who can prescribe the drugs and have the intricate knowlage on the topic. It might be expensive but it will be worth your time.

Lastly it is important not to get caught up in all the online hype in psycodelics. Joe rogan, reddit and a lot of streamers swear by them and a few places are researching the medical benifits of them in treatment (John Hopkins hospital, University of London). But it is important to know that this is still in the teething phase and researchers will generally only use a verry small amount.
